field.name: Write the child's full name as on the birth certificate.
field.dob: Pick the child's date of birth.
field.birth_reg_no: The number on the birth certificate.
field.photo: The photo is added as a document below.
field.father_occupation: What the father does for work.
field.father_nid: The number on the father's national ID card.
field.mother_occupation: What the mother does for work.
field.mother_nid: The number on the mother's national ID card.
field.guardian_name: The person who will come to the school. Often a parent.
field.guardian_phone: 11 digits, starting with 01. Messages go to this number.
field.permanent_address: The home village or town address.
field.previous_school: The school the child went to before.
field.previous_class: The last class the child passed.
field.ssc_gpa: The GPA on the SSC result, for example 4.50.
field.ssc_roll: The roll number on the SSC result.
field.ssc_board: The education board of the SSC exam.
field.ssc_year: The year of the SSC exam.
field.siblings_in_school: Tick if a brother or sister studies here.
field.quota_freedom_fighter: Tick if the child is a freedom fighter's child. A certificate may be asked for.
field.quota_teacher_child: Tick if a parent teaches at this school.
field.quota_disabled: Tick if the child has a disability. A certificate may be asked for.
field.quota_ethnic_minority: Tick if the child belongs to a small ethnic group.
field.special_needs: Anything the school should know to help the child.
field.transport_need: Tick if the child needs a way to get to school.
field.heard_of_us: For example a friend, a banner or the website.
